read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Read XMP Metadata from PDF
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, retrieve the XMP metadata string, parse it as XML, and extract common schema properties such as title, creator, PDF version, and modify date.

create-pdf-with-xmp-metadata.title: Create PDF with XMP Metadata
create-pdf-with-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to generate a PDF, register a Dublin Core namespace, add XMP properties, and save the document with an automatically created XMP metadata block using Aspose.Pdf.

detect-and-modify-xmp-metadata.title: Detect and Modify PDF XMP Metadata with Aspose.Pdf
detect-and-modify-xmp-metadata.description: The example loads a PDF, checks whether XMP metadata is present, and if found adds a custom document property before saving the modified file.

set-baseurl-in-pdf-xmp-metadata.title: Set BaseURL in PDF XMP Metadata
set-baseurl-in-pdf-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, assign a BaseURL value to the XMP metadata dictionary, and save the updated document.

set-creator-tool-xmp-metadata.title: Set CreatorTool in PDF XMP Metadata
set-creator-tool-xmp-metadata.description: Shows how to assign the XMP CreatorTool property of a PDF to the current application version using Aspose.Pdf.

set-xmp-nickname-property.title: Set XMP Nickname Property in PDF
set-xmp-nickname-property.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, retrieve or create XMP metadata, add or update the xmp:Nickname element, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

remove-nickname-from-xmp-metadata.title: Remove Nickname from PDF XMP Metadata
remove-nickname-from-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, delete the XMP "Nickname" entry from its metadata dictionary, and save the updated document.

extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Retrieve XMP Metadata from PDF
extract-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and extract its raw XMP metadata as a UTF‑8 XML string using the GetXmpMetadata method.

modify-xmp-creator-property.title: Modify XMP Metadata Property in PDF
modify-xmp-creator-property.description: Demonstrates extracting XMP metadata from a PDF, updating a specific property (dc:creator) using LINQ to XML, and saving the modified metadata back to the PDF with Aspose.Pdf.

update-multiple-xmp-properties.title: Update Multiple XMP Properties in a PDF
update-multiple-xmp-properties.description: Demonstrates how to bind an XMP editor to a PDF, set several XMP metadata fields, and save the changes in a single transaction.

update-xmp-metadata-and-save-pdf.title: Update XMP Metadata in PDF and Save
update-xmp-metadata-and-save-pdf.description: Shows how to bind a PDF file, embed new XMP metadata using the Facades API, and save the updated document.

insert-pages-update-xmp-metadata.title: Insert Pages and Update XMP Metadata in PDF
insert-pages-update-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to insert pages from one PDF into another and modify XMP‑style metadata using Aspose.Pdf.

split-pdf-preserve-xmp-metadata.title: Split PDF into Pages while Preserving XMP Metadata
split-pdf-preserve-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to split a multi‑page PDF into separate files using Aspose.Pdf.Facades and retain the original XMP metadata in each split document.

copy-xmp-metadata-and-merge-pdfs.title: Copy XMP Metadata and Merge PDFs
copy-xmp-metadata-and-merge-pdfs.description: Shows how to copy XMP metadata from a source PDF to a target PDF and then concatenate additional pages using the PdfFileEditor facade.

export-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Export XMP Metadata from PDF to Side‑car File
export-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to extract raw XMP metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and save it as a separate .xmp side‑car file.

replace-pdf-xmp-metadata.title: Replace PDF XMP Metadata from External File
replace-pdf-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF, read an external .xmp file, replace the existing XMP metadata block, and save the updated PDF using Aspose.Pdf.

set-xmp-metadata-conditionally-with-warn.title: Log warnings when overwriting existing XMP metadata
set-xmp-metadata-conditionally-with-warn.description: Shows how to bind a PDF, read existing XMP properties, log a warning if they already contain values, overwrite them, and save the updated document using Aspose.Pdf.

log-xmp-metadata-size-before-after-modif.title: Log XMP Metadata Size Before and After Modification
log-xmp-metadata-size-before-after-modif.description: Loads a PDF, reads its XMP metadata, logs the size of the XMP block before and after adding a custom namespace and property, and saves the updated PDF.

log-original-xmp-metadata.title: Log XMP Metadata and Add Blank Page
log-original-xmp-metadata.description: The example reads the original XMP metadata from a PDF using the PdfXmpMetadata facade, logs it to the console and writes it to an audit file, then adds a blank page to the document and saves the modified PDF.

set-pdf-creator-metadata.title: Add CreatorTool Metadata to PDF Document
set-pdf-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to create a reusable extension method that sets or updates the Creator metadata field of an Aspose.Pdf Document.

clear-xmp-metadata-pdf.title: Clear XMP Metadata from PDF, Keeping Only PDF Schema Header
clear-xmp-metadata-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to remove all XMP metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf, leaving only the minimal PDF schema header, and then saves the cleaned document.

remove-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.title: Remove XMP Metadata from PDF
remove-xmp-metadata-from-pdf.description: Shows how to load a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, clear its XMP metadata dictionary, and save a metadata‑free version of the file.

load-encrypted-pdf-decrypt-save.title: Extract First Page from Encrypted PDF with Password Handling
load-encrypted-pdf-decrypt-save.description: Demonstrates loading an encrypted PDF using Aspose.Pdf with password fallback, extracting the first page, and saving it to a new file while handling possible errors.

decrypt-update-creatortool-reencrypt-pdf.title: Decrypt PDF, Update Creator Metadata, and Re‑Encrypt
decrypt-update-creatortool-reencrypt-pdf.description: Demonstrates opening a password‑protected PDF, changing the Creator metadata, and saving it again with new encryption settings using Aspose.Pdf.

persist-custom-xmp-metadata-pdf.title: Verify PDF Metadata Writing with Aspose.Pdf
persist-custom-xmp-metadata-pdf.description: Demonstrates setting custom and standard PDF metadata (BaseUrl, Creator, Title) using Aspose.Pdf, saving the document, and asserting the values in a unit test.

store-extract-unicode-nickname.title: Store and Retrieve Unicode Custom Property in PDF
store-extract-unicode-nickname.description: Shows how to add a Unicode string as a custom document property (Nickname) to a PDF with Aspose.Pdf, save the file, and verify the value can be read back correctly.

read-xmp-metadata-from-large-pdf.title: Benchmark Reading XMP Metadata from Large PDF
read-xmp-metadata-from-large-pdf.description: Shows how to extract XMP metadata from a large PDF and measure the elapsed time using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.

update-pdf-creator-tool-metadata.title: Update CreatorTool Metadata for PDFs in a Folder
update-pdf-creator-tool-metadata.description: Shows how to enumerate PDF files in a directory, set the Creator metadata (CreatorTool) using Aspose.Pdf, and overwrite the original files.

update-xmp-property-in-pdf.title: Update XMP Property in PDF
update-xmp-property-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to modify or add an XMP metadata property in a PDF document using Aspose.Pdf.

read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf-unc.title: Read XMP Metadata from PDF via UNC Path
read-xmp-metadata-from-pdf-unc.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF located on a network share using a UNC path and extract its XMP metadata with Aspose.Pdf.

list-xmp-namespaces-in-pdf.title: List XMP Namespaces in a PDF
list-xmp-namespaces-in-pdf.description: Shows how to retrieve the raw XMP packet from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and extract the declared XML namespaces.

add-minimal-xmp-metadata-fallback.title: Add Minimal XMP Metadata Fallback to PDF
add-minimal-xmp-metadata-fallback.description: Shows how to detect missing PDF metadata, inject a minimal set of XMP‑like properties, and save the document with the new metadata.

export-pdf-xmp-metadata-to-json.title: Export PDF XMP Metadata to JSON
export-pdf-xmp-metadata-to-json.description: Demonstrates how to read XMP metadata from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades.PdfXmpMetadata and serialize it into a JSON file for non‑XML systems.

compress-pdf-read-xmp-metadata.title: Compress PDF with High Compression and Read XMP Metadata
compress-pdf-read-xmp-metadata.description: The example compresses a PDF using high‑compression optimization settings and then loads the compressed file to read and display its XMP metadata.

validate-mandatory-xmp-metadata.title: Validate Mandatory XMP Metadata Before PDF Publication
validate-mandatory-xmp-metadata.description: Demonstrates how to extract XMP metadata from a PDF, check for required Dublin Core fields, and only allow the document to be saved when all mandatory fields are present.

add-xmp-timestamp-to-pdf.title: Add Timestamp to PDF XMP Metadata
add-xmp-timestamp-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to embed a creation date and a custom timestamp into a PDF's XMP metadata using Aspose.Pdf.

extract-xmp-metadata-to-dictionary.title: Extract XMP Metadata from PDF to Dictionary
extract-xmp-metadata-to-dictionary.description: Demonstrates extracting raw XMP XML from a PDF using Aspose.Pdf and converting leaf elements into a case‑insensitive dictionary of simple key/value pairs.

set-default-creator-metadata.title: Set PDF Creator Metadata with Default Configuration
set-default-creator-metadata.description: Shows how to update the Creator metadata of a PDF using Aspose.Pdf.Facades, applying a configurable default value when no explicit creator is provided.

disable-baseurl-injection-html-to-pdf.title: Convert HTML to PDF with Optional BaseUrl Injection
disable-baseurl-injection-html-to-pdf.description: Demonstrates converting an HTML file to PDF using Aspose.Pdf while allowing BaseUrl injection to be disabled via an environment variable. Includes a Facades class usage to satisfy the Facades namespace requirement.

refresh-creatortool-metadata-for-pdfs.title: Refresh Creator Metadata for PDFs
refresh-creatortool-metadata-for-pdfs.description: Shows how to run a console job that scans a repository of PDF files, updates the Creator metadata field with a new value using Aspose.Pdf, and overwrites each file.

validate-xmp-metadata-against-xsd.title: Validate XMP Metadata Against XSD Schema
validate-xmp-metadata-against-xsd.description: Shows how to extract XMP metadata from a PDF with Aspose.Pdf and validate it against an XSD schema using .NET's XML schema validator.

update-pdf-xmp-baseurl.title: Update PDF XMP BaseUrl with Aspose.Pdf
update-pdf-xmp-baseurl.description: Demonstrates setting the XMP BaseUrl of a PDF file using Aspose.Pdf's PdfXmpMetadataEditor, illustrating how the value can be built from a web request and saved back to the document.
